summary.intent: Fix a race in addrConn where connect() released ac.mu after the Idle check and resetTransport re-acquired it, letting two concurrent connect() calls both start connection attempts (issue #7365, flaky AuthorityRevive; orphaned transports).
summary.issue_fit: Met. The state moves to Connecting inside the same critical section as the Idle check, so a second connect() sees non-Idle. No regression test was added; the author reports 100000 clean runs of Test/AuthorityRevive, which this review could not repeat.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (`clientconn.go`) reviewed with callers, `onClose` and `GracefulClose` paths. Focused run at head: `go test -race ./test/ -run 'Test/(StateTransitions|UpdateAddresses|PickFirst)'` passed (exit 0); a root-package focused run matched no tests. Three concurrency safety premises were verified in one awaited batch and all held.

observations.fact: The PR adds no regression test for the concurrent-connect race; it relies on the existing flaky Test/AuthorityRevive.
observations.evidence: `clientconn.go` is the only file in the range.

requirements.source: pr-body/"ensures that no concurrent requests are able to start"
requirements.evidence: clientconn.go:914-922 keeps ac.mu from the Idle check through resetTransportAndUnlock, which sets Connecting (1261) before Unlock (1262); premise-3 holds
connect() no longer unlocks between the Idle check and the Connecting transition; updateAddrs hands the lock to the goroutine (clientconn.go:996)

requirements.source: pr-body/"Verified that Test/AuthorityRevive no longer flakes for 100000 attempts"
requirements.evidence: Author-run measurement on forge; not repeatable offline and not needed for the product-code judgment

tasks.premise: Every path through resetTransportAndUnlock releases ac.mu exactly once and both callers hold it on entry.
Handing ac.mu from updateAddrs to the spawned goroutine cannot deadlock with the deferred GracefulClose/onClose.
State becomes Connecting before ac.mu is released after the Idle check, so no second concurrent attempt starts.
